readingLetter.slip.titleAnnual: Your {period} annual reading letter is here
readingLetter.slip.sub: Folds away the day after opening; if unread, waits quietly until {graceEnd}
readingLetter.env.body: This letter stays quietly outside your shelf. Once opened today, you can revisit it or save a keepsake image at any time; tomorrow it folds itself away.
readingLetter.env.sealAria: Break seal to open this letter
readingLetter.monthly.sub: Reading notes for {year}-{month} · written for you
readingLetter.monthly.proseFull: This month held {duration} of reading across {days} days, mostly in the company of {topBook}.
readingLetter.monthly.proseHiddenDuratio: You opened pages on {days} days this month across {books}, most often with {topBook}; exact times are kept private.
readingLetter.monthly.proseExcluded: Every book from this month has been hidden by your choice; the quiet days spent reading still count.
readingLetter.monthly.calIntro: Each day keeps the book read longest; a vermilion dot marks days with notes.
readingLetter.monthly.dayEmpty: No visible records on this day.
readingLetter.monthly.booksIntro: Each tile scales with time spent; tap to inspect or hide a title from your keepsake.
readingLetter.monthly.rhythmSummary: Pages mostly turned in your quietest hours; the longest sitting was day {day} with {book} ({duration}).
readingLetter.monthly.rhythmSummaryNoDur: Most pages turned during your quietest hours of the day.
readingLetter.monthly.colophon: This page lingers only for month {month}. Tomorrow it folds away, while every chapter and note stays safely inside your books.
readingLetter.empty.title: A quiet blank month.
readingLetter.empty.body: {period} left no reading records behind — reading moves at its own pace. Whenever you reach for a book next, it will be waiting on your shelf.
readingLetter.annual.sub: January to December · gathered into one New Year letter
readingLetter.annual.prose: No streaks, no daily quotas — just the quiet trace of days spent reading across the year.
readingLetter.annual.choiceHeading: II · Your Book of the Year
readingLetter.annual.choiceIntro: Not picked by a timer — stamp the book that stayed with you most, and add an optional line for the year.
readingLetter.annual.epigraphLabel: A closing line for {year} (printed on the keepsake)
readingLetter.annual.epigraphPlaceholder: Write a line for this year's reading…
readingLetter.annual.colophon: SeLis · Annual Letter · generated locally on your device
